title: Katiiti's Song
summary: Every day Katiiti's mother calls her with a beautiful, special song. One day a sneaky gorilla tries to sing the song just as sweetly as Mother.
pages: Katiiti lived in a village near a forest.

She loved to play in the forest.
Mother told her to be careful.
Every day Mother would sing their special song to call her.
One day, Katiiti came across a gorilla.
She ran and hid in a cave.
The gorilla came and sang Mother's song in a deep, rough voice.
The gorilla ate lots of bananas, to make his voice sweeter.
The gorilla sang a little more sweetly.
The gorilla went and ate lots of honey, to make his voice even sweeter.
The gorilla sang just as sweetly as Mother.
Mother arrived just in time and chased the gorilla away.
Katiiti and Mother sang all the way home.
